item.title: 2025 Aug to Oct Build Update
item.description: Let’s set the scene - it’s a sweltering 39 degrees in Spring (in celsius of course), the kind of heat that makes the air shimmer and the tools too hot to touch. The pollen is out in full force (it’s 100% worse this year), and the skylights are working overtime to pull in whatever breeze they can muster…and you’re oiling a kitchen bench top. Table Of Contents Shower Doors Kitchens Wedding Season Essentially, we’re on the final home straight - but my goodness it’s the longest home straight we’ve been on!
